name: Piles! A Fast-Paced Free-For-All

categories.label: Won the race (6 matching sets)
categories.hint: First player with all six piles face-up as matching sets slaps the table and wins; verify piles.

categories.label: Completed matching sets
categories.labelVi: Số chồng bài đã đủ bộ
categories.hint: Piles turned face-up as a matching set of four (0-6).

winCondition: Real-time race with no turns: the first player whose six piles are all face-up matching sets declares 'Piles!'; if a pile is not a matching set, play resumes.

endCondition.description: A player has six face-up piles, each a matching set, and the claim is verified

notes: family: race-objective. No point scoring; no tiebreaker stated in the rulebook (first to claim wins). Variant: add one more set to the deck and deal eight centre cards (not modelled).

sources.title: Piles! Rulebook (Lost Boy Entertainment, English)
